title: Trusted financial data for agentic commerce: A multi-agent framework for credit risk, fraud detection, and secure payment decisions
abstract: arXiv:2611.18651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial institutions increasingly require intelligent risk-management systems that combine predictive performance with data reliability, interpretability, and adaptable decision policies for emerging agentic commerce environments. This study proposes a Trusted Financial Data (TFD) Multi-Agent Framework that integrates predictive risk modeling, behavioral intelligence, data-trust assessment, explainable artificial intelligence, and uncertainty-aware decision orchestration for credit-default and payment-fraud management. The framework translates heterogeneous risk and trust signals into interpretable Approve, Review, and Decline decisions using fixed and adaptive decision policies. Experimental evaluation was conducted on the Home Credit Default Risk and IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection datasets against five machine-learning baselines: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Multi-Layer Perceptron. Adaptive TFD achieved recall

translated_title: 面向智能体商务的可信金融数据：一个用于信用风险、欺诈检测与安全支付决策的多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 金融机构日益需要能够将预测性能与数据可靠性、可解释性以及适应新兴智能体商务环境的灵活决策策略相结合的智能风险管理系统。本研究提出了一种可信金融数据多智能体框架，该框架集成了预测风险建模、行为智能、数据信任评估、可解释人工智能以及不确定性感知的决策编排，用于信用违约和支付欺诈管理。该框架利用固定和自适应决策策略，将异构的风险与信任信号转化为可解释的批准、审查和拒绝决策。实验评估在Home Credit Default Risk和IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection两个数据集上进行，并与五种机器学习基线模型进行了对比：逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM和多层感知器。自适应TFD实现了召回率……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向智能体商务的可信金融数据多智能体框架，通过融合预测风险建模、数据信任评估与可解释AI，将风险信号转化为可解释的批准、审查和拒绝决策，并在信用违约与支付欺诈检测任务上超越了多种机器学习基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Trusted Financial Data multi-agent framework for agentic commerce that integrates predictive risk modeling, data-trust assessment, and explainable AI to translate risk signals into interpretable Approve, Review, and Decline decisions, outperforming multiple machine learning baselines on credit default and payment fraud detection tasks.
